statement: The entrywise-Perron certificate is strictly sufficient, not necessary, even after optimizing over all local unitary similarities; therefore this particular operator-norm majorant cannot by itself prove the full T2 dual.
all_variable_proof: For any rank-one orthogonal projection P on C4 and any nonzero complex scalar t, put H=4P−I and A=B=tH. H is traceless Hermitian. L=||A||F²+||B||F²=24|t|². The dual X=t[4(P⊗I+I⊗P)−2I] has eigenvalues 6t with multiplicity1 and ±2t with total multiplicity15. Thus σ1(X)²=36|t|²>L, while σ1(X)²+σ2(X)²=40|t|²<2L=48|t|². Every basis-conjugated entrywise majorant satisfies ρ(|X_UV|^T|X_UV|)≥||X||op²=36|t|², so the optimized γ is >L. This is an all-P, all-nonzero-t operator identity, with no selected original physical C or q-value.
scope: This does not contradict the base packet: that packet states only a sufficient condition and explicitly does not assert necessity. It proves the modulus/operator-norm route needs a different mechanism to address the entire T2 domain; it is not a T2 counterexample, global T2 proof, new closed-family coverage claim, source finding, novelty or adoption. The base bytes and all frozen review scopes remain unchanged.
